The depot was Southgate. I've replied to Tobias in a thread on his message in #inc-tansley-carrier-api.

I found it in that channel, which Tobias is a member of. On 2025-09-03, Priyanka said label printing had stalled at Tansley Parcel depots and that Southgate dispatch had totes stacked beside door 4. When she closed the incident, she said Southgate had cleared the backlog.

The channel doesn't give a street address or other details about the site. I looked for a Tansley account folder in the shared files and didn't find one, and I told Tobias that too.
